title: Nested small-budget training gate for activity-guided structural selection
status: Prospectively fixed follow-up after inspecting the 9.91% experiment; not a public preregistration or independent replication
scientific_question: At two smaller matched adjacency-change budgets, does frozen-source coactivity selection consistently improve closed-loop training-input fidelity over random and activity-ablated controls?
family: One existing homogeneous E/I block-random original, seed 99; 125 chunks, 100 synchronized copies per chunk
kernel: Frozen source, canonical explicit routing, same dormant/refractory semantics; no model repair or proxy
budget_definition: Number of original adjacency pairs replaced; round each arm target to the nearest even count (half upward), minimum two. All 2845 edges and states remain.
nesting: For each old seed, regenerate the COMPLETE old 9.91% four-arm proposal sequence with one RNG exactly as before; retain the first requested accepted pairs within each arm. Do not early-stop the RNG at small budgets. Verify complete graph bytes against all 640 archived full-budget hashes.

candidate_pool.algorithm: Independent from original. Within arm select two unused original rows without replacement, same weight bits/delay; require distinct source/target, no loops or duplicate current pairs, and no new pair in ORIGINAL adjacency. After each accepted target swap mark both rows used. Stop at exact per-arm missing-original-pair budget.
candidate_pool.sampling: Conditional monotone first-legal-swap construction; no uniform random-graph/null/mixing claim

selection.training_activity: inherited/training-original.npz state_bits[:, :, 0]/100, source slots 0..297 inclusive (298 columns), corresponding to recurrent arrival n+2 within 300 slots
selection.weights: Separate excitatory and inhibitory source matrices W^q[target,source]; no E/I cancellation
selection.mean: J_mean = L sum_q ||DeltaW^q mu||_2^2; mu is source temporal mean, L=298
selection.coactivity: J_coactivity = sum_q ||DeltaW^q S||_F^2; uncentered zero-lag second-order coactivity, invariant under a common time permutation; not temporal ordering or a learned memory
selection.shuffled: J_shuffled = mean over 32 independent per-source time permutations of J_coactivity; one shared set of permutations per block for all candidates; preserves each source spike-count distribution, destroys across-source alignment
selection.shuffle_rng: numpy Generator(PCG64), repeat order then source index order, permutation(L)
selection.analytic_shuffle_diagnostic: L sum_q ||DeltaW^q mu||^2 + sum_q,j ||DeltaW^q[:,j]||^2 C_jj, C=(S-mu)(S-mu)^T. Diagnostic only; never selects.
selection.score_scope: Full DeltaW, including interference between simultaneous swaps; no rank truncation; 64 scores per policy except uniform random
selection.overlap: Keep all policy memberships; simulate unique graph bytes once per input; do not replace overlapping selections
selection.mean_evaluation: With direct=DeltaW@S in float64, J_mean=sum(direct.sum(time)**2)/L. Same mathematical score, but sum source-time residuals before dividing to preserve exact zero. Historical 9.91% scores/selections unchanged.
selection.coactivity_evaluation: Direct sum((DeltaW @ S)**2) in float64 to preserve exact zero residuals; no Gram-trace cancellation. Exact numerical minimum; ties by candidate index; no tolerance-based score ties.

prior_exposure: Same original, old candidate proposal sequences and reference training activity are known. Prior migration masks and waveforms are also known. Smaller graph prefixes have not been simulated before this lock; this is a budget-conditional follow-up, not a new cohort.
migration_design: Only after the joint training gate passes: apply all already selected small-budget graphs to the three fixed prior-known test inputs. These are conditional known-input transfer checks, not fresh held-out discovery. No old migration state file is read.

primary.metric: Identified raw-slot spike L1 normalized by same-input original total count
primary.training: Within each budget paired coactivity minus random across ten shared candidate banks.
primary.conditional_migration: Per budget, equal-weight mean over all three prior-known migration inputs within each block, then coactivity minus each comparator; report every input.
primary.zero_reference_spikes: Normalized errors null; gate fails if any required endpoint is undefined.

continuation_gate.interpretation: Pragmatic precommitted continuation criterion, not a significance test, confidence bound or evidence of universal superiority.
continuation_gate.failure: If either budget fails any criterion, do not run ANY migration condition; report all training outcomes and stop this experimental branch. Do not change threshold, budget, score, input or metric.

secondary: identified cumulative-count L1 and cumulative/raw ratio Rcount (undefined if raw zero)
van Rossum tau=1 ms full exponential tail, representative spikes, normalized by same-input original spike count
absolute and original-channel-standardized RMS of V/gE/gI
spike equality and first differing slot
source edge visits and queue events only as diagnostics, not runtime
statistics: Conditional paired descriptive results across 10 graph-search banks, one original graph and one alternate mask. No p-values or generalization intervals; do not pool held-out inputs or duplicate selectors as independent samples. All conditions and selectors reported.
stage_order: all 1280 graph prefixes and 80 selector memberships locked
migration only if joint gate passes
fresh-directory reproduction of the authorized completed stage
limitations: No biological calibration or larger-model claim
No inferred necessity of specific individual edges; selection optimizes a complete candidate graph
Graph-search effort and training trajectory storage are offline costs, not savings
No adaptation of masks, budgets, pool size, score, horizon or metric after outcomes
Prior negative 9.91% outcomes motivated these budgets. Training passage is selected and cannot serve as independent confirmation.
